observations.question: Why did the API return HTTP 503 after deployment?
observations.answer: The API returned HTTP 503 because PostgreSQL connections were exhausted after deployment. The team reduced the application connection pool to 20 and closed leaked connections. No database restart was required. [S1]

citations.excerpt:
# Database recovery

The API returned HTTP 503 because PostgreSQL connections were exhausted after deployment. The team reduced the application connection pool to 20 and closed leaked connections. No database restart was required.
